lanes.summary:
Verified PMAT-3694 diff against ticket requirements, acceptance criteria, and notes:
1. Python-free classify(): `scripts/parity_receipt_denominator.sh` replaces python3 `classify()` with an independent iterative RFC 8259 parser in POSIX awk under `LC_ALL=C`. It validates UTF-8 bytes (RFC 3629), decodes ASCII and `\uXXXX` escapes, enforces numeric syntax, handles later duplicate keys winning, and guards against raw NUL byte truncation across C-string awks.
2. Removal of UNMEASURED exit 3: Removed `PY_BIN`/`PARITY_PYTHON` and the exit 3 UNMEASURED paths from `scripts/parity_receipt_denominator.sh`. In `crates/aprender-contracts-cli/tests/ont4c3_parity_receipts.rs`, the exit 3 acceptance was removed, strictly enforcing `out.status.success()`.
3. Corpus & Self-test: Real corpus passes with `PASS 7 receipt(s) under evidence/parity/**, and evidence/parity/EXPECTED_RECEIPTS says 7.` `--self-test` passes all 9 rows (including the 35-row classification table) across `gawk`, `mawk`, and `busybox awk`.
4. Differential & Mutants: Differential test against python `json.load` over all 118 evidence files yielded 0 mismatches. All 6 candidate mutants (substring classifier, duplicate key ordering, UTF-8 validator bypass, trailing content, schema kind validation, and NUL precheck) were measured and verified RED.
5. Cargo Tests & Lints: `cargo test -p aprender-contracts-cli --test ont4c3_parity_receipts` passes 9/9 tests on standard and python-free PATHs. `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `bashrs lint`, and `check_shell_lint_ratchet.sh` pass cleanly. `docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml` is clean and generated via `make roadmap-aggregate`.
